Estimated items: orange juice, about 200 ml, ~90 kcal; one slice of toast, ~75 kcal; avocado, about half a fruit, ~120 kcal; one egg (poached or fried), ~90 kcal.

Served total is about 375 kcal.

This is a before-eating photo, so I assumed the person eats nearly everything and leaves about 5% (~15 kcal), which makes about 360 kcal eaten.

Macros for the amount eaten:
- Juice: 1.5 g protein, 21 g carbs, 0.5 g fat
- Toast: 2.5 g protein, 14 g carbs, 1 g fat
- Avocado: 1.5 g protein, 6 g carbs, 11 g fat
- Egg: 6 g protein, 0.5 g carbs, 7 g fat

Together that is about 11.5 g protein, 41.5 g carbs and 19.5 g fat, which I rounded slightly down for the small leftover.
